title: Zutty Singleton learns drums; return to St. Louis; New Orleans trombonists
summary: Bill stays with Zutty Singleton and teaches him drums, returns to St. Louis, and names the best New Orleans trombonists.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
